visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair wearing a black backless top stands in a crowded indoor market. She is looking at a food stall, and a large yellow caption with a crocodile emoji appears on screen alongside her social media handles. (2) The camera pans as she turns to face the lens, offering a slightly awkward but friendly smile. The background is filled with warm, festive market lighting and various food stalls. (3) The shot cuts to the woman walking past stalls selling grilled items; she gestures with her hands as she speaks excitedly. A striped barrier tape is visible in front of a counter. (4) A close-up reveals a whole roasted crocodile head displayed on a counter, decorated with a small orange Halloween witch hat featuring a pumpkin. (5) Back to the woman speaking, she is now in a different section of the market with dining tables and people eating in the background. She uses animated facial expressions and hand movements. (6) A close-up shot shows skewers of fried scorpions, giant spiders, and centipedes arranged in a tray, with small Thai flags stuck into the skewers and price tags visible. (7) The woman points towards the insect stall while laughing and talking to someone off-camera. She looks surprised yet amused. (8) The final visual phase is a zoomed-in pan over trays of smaller fried insects and crickets. (9) The video ends on a graphic outro card with the woman's portrait inside a floral wreath, accompanied by interactive icons for liking and subscribing.
